description: Base capability. tidal2ytm grants three narrow plugin permissions: dialog:allow-open for importing a client secret file, fs:allow-appdata-read-recursive and fs:allow-appdata-write-recursive for reading and writing log files under app data, and opener:allow-open-path scoped to $APPDATA/** for opening log files and directories. The sidecar is spawned from Rust, and every other command the frontend calls is a custom #[tauri::command] that needs no permission.
